content:
Marta (Support): FYI customer reported being charged twice for the same renewal after attaching a PO retroactively. invoices INV-2026-117 and INV-2026-118 both show paid. customer requesting refund + reconciliation note. cc @Sean @Ryan

Sean (Billing): acknowledged. can someone paste gateway txns and webhook traces? need to know which system path issued the second charge. :thinking_face:

Marta (Support): pulled logs for acct_5421. short timeline:
- 2026-06-15T09:03:12Z payment succeeded for INV-2026-117 (gateway txn g_9001)
- 2026-06-15T09:03:28Z purchase_order.attached for po_017 (webhook)
- 2026-06-15T09:03:29Z invoice.regenerate(trigger=po_attach) created INV-2026-118
- shortly after, PO-collection job captured payment against INV-2026-118 (gateway txn g_9002)

Log excerpt:
```
payment.succeeded -> invoice INV-2026-117, txn g_9001
purchase_order.attached -> po_017, subscription sub_A12
invoice.regenerate(trigger=po_attach) -> old=INV-2026-117 new=INV-2026-118
gateway.capture -> txn g_9002 invoice INV-2026-118
```

Ryan (Ops): that matches a race. invoice.regenerate should be idempotent and must check whether the original invoice is already paid before emitting a new invoice. also the PO attach webhook needs deduping on retry. I'll investigate the mutexes and webhook handler. :mag:

payments-bot: gateway_summary: [{"id":"g_9001","status":"succeeded","amount":7500,"invoice":"INV-2026-117"},{"id":"g_9002","status":"succeeded","amount":7500,"invoice":"INV-2026-118"}], webhooks: [{"id":"wh_101","status":200},{"id":"wh_102","status":500,"retry":true}]

Lina (Finance): we'll need a credit note CN-2026-210 referencing INV-2026-118. GL impact: reverse revenue for the duplicate invoice and issue customer-facing credit. include PO po_017 in reconciliation memo.

Sean (Billing): proposed immediate actions:
- refund gateway txn g_9002 (initiate refund rf_7701)
- mark INV-2026-118 as cancelled and set metadata "duplicate_of": "INV-2026-117"
- create CN-2026-210 and attach to INV-2026-118 + PO po_017
- send customer-facing explanation and timeline

Marta (Support): starting refund run now. will update when gateway returns result. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

payments-bot: refund_initiated -> {"refund_id":"rf_7701","status":"pending","gateway_ref":"g_ref_7701"}

Sean (Billing): put reconciliation automation on hold for this account until Ops patch. adding internal audit tag "dup-invoice-1706".

Ryan (Ops): opened OPS-5440. fix plan:
1) make po_attach webhook handler idempotent (store webhook id/signature and ignore duplicates)
2) on invoice.regenerate, check original_invoice.payment_state != "paid" before creating a new invoice
3) add an integration test simulating concurrent payment + PO attach
ETA: 72 hours for patch + smoke deploy.

Marta (Support): payments bot reports refund completed: rf_7701 settled for $75.00. customer confirmed receipt. created follow-up ticket SPT-6110 for post-mortem and shared OPS-5440 with customer-facing note. closing once customer confirms no further issues. thanks team :white_check_mark:
